text: Vision of the Department of Computer Science & Engineering, NIT Delhi: To communicate quality Computer Science Education for producing globally identifiable skilled technocrats and entrepreneurs upholding sound ethics, profound knowledge, and innovative ideas to meet industrial and societal expectations.

Goal of the Department of Computer Science & Engineering, NIT Delhi: To prepare the students with strong fundamental knowledge for challenging careers in the sciences, humanities and management to lay a strong foundation for higher study and research to mark a global impact.

Mission of the Department of Computer Science & Engineering, NIT Delhi: M1: Impart value-based technical knowledge and skill via effective pedagogies and hands-on experience. | M2: Strengthen multifaceted competence, nurture creativity, and foster entrepreneurial mindsets. | M3: Develop an appetite for research and higher education in contemporary computer science. | M4: Inculcate ethical and social values essential for nation-building.
